routine.title: Routines
routine.blankDescription: Routines are async jobs that scheduleAgent chat-flow nodes fire and wait on. Create one to get started.
routine.detailsDesc: Stable name and human-readable description. The name is referenced by scheduleAgent nodes.
routine.name: Name
routine.nameDesc: Unique identifier — letters, digits, underscore, hyphen, dot. Cannot start with a digit.
routine.descriptionPlaceholder: What does this routine do? Surfaced in the scheduleAgent dropdown.
routine.executionDesc: Choose how the routine runs and what it executes.
routine.kindDesc: NATIVE wraps a Spring AI @Tool method (the same registry functionCall uses). GROOVY runs an inline script.
routine.nativeToolNameDesc: Name of the @Tool method to invoke (e.g. get_current_time, search_site).
routine.nativeToolNameRequired: Native tool name is required when kind is NATIVE.
routine.groovyScriptDesc: Bindings: args (parsed payload Map + each top-level key), conversationId, routineName. The last expression is written to the scheduleAgent node's output slot.
routine.groovyScriptRequired: Groovy script body is required when kind is GROOVY.
routine.defaultTimeoutMsDesc: Fallback timeout for scheduleAgent nodes that don't set their own. The flow takes the 'timeout' edge when expired.
routine.enabledDesc: Disabled routines are skipped (scheduleAgent logs a warning and advances the flow).
routine.saveFailed: Could not save routine. Check the form for validation errors.
routine.createDescription: Author a new routine that scheduleAgent nodes can fire across any chat flow.
routine.editDescription: Edit a routine — changes apply to all flows that reference it.
